articles.title: Woman Molested on Marudhar Express at Agra Fort, Brother Assaulted; Accused Escapes from GRP Custody
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Agra (UP): A young woman travelling on the Marudhar Express was allegedly molested by a group of men at Agra Fort railway station, triggering outrage after one of the accused reportedly escaped from GRP custody.

body.html:
Agra (UP): A young woman travelling on the Marudhar Express was allegedly molested by a group of men at Agra Fort railway station, triggering outrage after one of the accused reportedly escaped from GRP custody.

According to the family, when the woman objected to the misbehaviour, her brother was brutally beaten by the accused. The brother managed to catch one of the suspects and handed him over to the Government Railway Police (GRP). However, the accused allegedly went missing from police custody shortly afterwards.

The victim’s family has accused the GRP of serious negligence, alleging delays in registering the complaint and claiming that the accused escaped under the watch of a plainclothes sub-inspector. Following the incident, the brother has reportedly been facing threats and intimidation.

The incident has raised fresh concerns over women’s safety on trains and accountability of railway police. No official statement has yet been issued on how the accused escaped from custody.

articles.title: Facebook Love Turns Fatal: Young Mother Found Dead, Husband Absconding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panki (UP): A woman who entered a relationship through Facebook was allegedly murdered in Panki’s Ramganga Enclave, with police suspecting her husband in the case.

body.html:
Panki (UP): A woman who entered a relationship through Facebook was allegedly murdered in Panki’s Ramganga Enclave, with police suspecting her husband in the case. The deceased, Deepika Saini, was found dead under suspicious circumstances in her rented second-floor flat, with visible injury marks suggesting strangulation.

Deep bruises were found on her neck and face, with clear thumb impressions indicating pressure on the throat. Her husband Shoaib, whom she married in October last year, is suspected to be involved and has been absconding since the incident.

According to neighbours, an argument broke out between the couple on Monday afternoon. Shoaib reportedly left the flat after the fight and returned later, breaking open the door when there was no response. He allegedly tried to revive Deepika before informing her brother and fleeing the spot.

Deepika lived with her two young sons, Rudra and Aniruddh, who were inconsolable after seeing their mother’s body. Her elderly grandmother was seen trying to comfort them.

Deepika’s mother said she had visited her earlier in the day and returned home after speaking to Shoaib on the phone. Police have sent the body for post-mortem and launched a search for the accused. Further investigation is underway.

#UPCrime #SuspiciousDeath #FacebookLove #DomesticViolence #WomenSafety #MurderCase #RamgangaEnclave

articles.title: Job Dreams Turn into Chaos Outside Adani Cement Office in Satna
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Satna (MP): Chaos broke out outside the Adani Cement office in Bharhut Nagar, Satna, on Sunday as hundreds of unemployed youth gathered for a recruitment drive.

body.html:
Satna (MP): Chaos broke out outside the Adani Cement office in Bharhut Nagar, Satna, on Sunday as hundreds of unemployed youth gathered for a recruitment drive. Aspirants from Satna, Katni, Maihar and Panna districts arrived early morning with resumes and documents, hoping to secure jobs, but the absence of a clear entry or management system led to disorder.

As the crowd swelled, there was barely space to stand inside or outside the office premises. After waiting for hours without access, frustration mounted among the youth. Some climbed the boundary wall, while others attempted to reach the roof using nearby buildings, risking their lives in desperation.

Local residents alerted the police after the situation worsened. Police reached the spot and tried to control the crowd, but tensions had already peaked.

The recruitment was reportedly for several posts, including electrical and mechanical engineers and machine operators. What began as a day of hope for many job seekers ultimately turned into a scene highlighting unemployment, mismanagement and growing desperation among the youth.

articles.title: HRTC Bus Plunges into Ditch in Dehradun, 3 Dead, Over 15 Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Dehradun (Uttarakhand): At least three people were killed and more than 15 others injured after a Himachal Road Transport Corporation (HRTC) bus plunged into a deep ditch in the Vikasnagar area of Dehradun on Tuesday morning.

body.html:
Dehradun (Uttarakhand): At least three people were killed and more than 15 others injured after a Himachal Road Transport Corporation (HRTC) bus plunged into a deep ditch in the Vikasnagar area of Dehradun on Tuesday morning.

The accident occurred near Sudoi Khad in the Kwanu area when the bus, travelling from Chaupal-Nerwa to Paonta Sahib, reportedly lost control while giving way to a truck. Officials said the road embankment collapsed, causing the bus to overturn several times before falling into the ditch. Over 30 passengers were on board at the time.

Local residents rushed to the spot and began rescue efforts. Police, district administration teams and the State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) were later deployed to carry out relief operations.

Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami expressed grief over the incident and said he was closely monitoring the situation. He directed officials to ensure immediate medical assistance and said critically injured passengers could be airlifted if required. Nearby hospitals have been placed on high alert.

Rescue and relief operations are ongoing, and authorities said further details are awaited.

#Dehradun #Uttarakhand #BusAccident #HRTC #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #RescueOperation #Vikasnagar

articles.title: Mumbai Woman Murdered Over Marriage Pressure, Body Dumped in Gorakhpur; Married Lover and Wife
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh): The identity of the young woman whose naked body was found in bushes under the Gobarhiya drain bridge in the PPganj police station area has been confirmed as Priya, a resident of Mumbai.

body.html:
Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh): The identity of the young woman whose naked body was found in bushes under the Gobarhiya drain bridge in the PPganj police station area has been confirmed as Priya, a resident of Mumbai. Police investigations have revealed that she was allegedly murdered by her married lover Vijay and his wife Sandhya after she pressured him to marry her.

According to police, Vijay, a resident of Marad Pali village under Sahajanwan police station, met Priya while working in a private job in Mumbai. The two developed a relationship and lived together. When Priya insisted that Vijay marry her and take her home, he allegedly fled Mumbai and returned to Gorakhpur. Priya later traced him to PPganj, where she discovered that he was already married and had two children.

Police said Priya was willing to become Vijay’s second wife, but his wife Sandhya opposed it. As domestic tensions increased, Vijay and Sandhya allegedly conspired to kill her. Vijay reportedly took Priya to a rented room in PPganj, made her consume excessive alcohol, strangled her with the help of his brother-in-law, and crushed her face with a brick to prevent identification.

The accused then stripped the body and dumped it in bushes under the Gobarhiya drain bridge, using a scooter belonging to Vijay’s father-in-law, a railway employee. Priya’s clothes were allegedly thrown near a riverbank to erase identification clues.

The case saw a major breakthrough after CCTV footage from PPganj town, including a camera near Allahabad Bank, showed three people leaving on a blue scooter around 11:20 pm on the night of the incident, while only two returned later. Based on this lead, police detained Vijay, his wife Sandhya, and his sister-in-law, who runs a beauty parlour in PPganj.

During interrogation, the accused reportedly confessed to the crime. Police have informed Priya’s family in Mumbai. A post-mortem will be conducted after the family arrives, following which the full conspiracy will be formally revealed.

Confirming the developments, CO Campierganj Anurag Singh said three accused have been taken into custody and are being questioned. Further legal action will follow after completion of identification and post-mortem procedures.

#Gorakhpur #UPCrime #MumbaiWoman #MurderCase #LoveAffair #CCTVBreakthrough #CrimeNews #PPganj #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Rewa: Two Drunk Women Create Ruckus on Road, Traffic Hit; Police Intervene
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rewa (Madhya Pradesh): A late-night commotion was reported from the Dhekha area under the Civil Lines police station on Sunday, where two heavily intoxicated women created chaos on a public road.

body.html:
Rewa (Madhya Pradesh): A late-night commotion was reported from the Dhekha area under the Civil Lines police station on Sunday, where two heavily intoxicated women created chaos on a public road. The women allegedly misbehaved with passersby, shouted abuses and attempted to vandalise parked vehicles, disrupting traffic on the busy Rewa–Satna main road for some time.

Eyewitnesses said both women were so drunk that they could barely stand, repeatedly holding each other and falling on the road. As the situation worsened, locals alerted the police. After reaching the spot, police struggled to control the women before counselling them and safely dropping them home.

During questioning, the women told police that a young man had called them to meet him, made them consume alcohol and later fled with their mobile phones. Police identified the women as residents of Chirhula Mohalla under Bichhiya police station limits. An investigation is underway.

A video of the incident, dated February 1, 2026, has gone viral on social media, drawing mixed reactions and raising concerns over public safety.

articles.title: Drunk Constable Assaults Wife on Road in Mancherial, Probe Launched
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mancherial (Telangana): A shocking incident was reported from Reddy Colony in Mancherial district headquarters in the early hours of midnight, where a police constable allegedly assaulted his wife on the road while in an inebriated condition.

body.html:
Mancherial (Telangana): A shocking incident was reported from Reddy Colony in Mancherial district headquarters in the early hours of midnight, where a police constable allegedly assaulted his wife on the road while in an inebriated condition.

The accused, Ravi Prasad, a constable posted at a Mancherial police station, is alleged to have brutally beaten his wife, Shireesha, following suspicion. At the time of the incident, Ravi Prasad was reportedly under the influence of alcohol and was seen in a semi-nude state on the road, causing public outrage.

Shireesha, who works as a superintendent in the Gudipet Battalion, later approached the police station and lodged a formal complaint against her husband. Based on her complaint, the police have registered a case and taken up an investigation into the matter.

The incident has sparked serious concerns, especially as it involves a serving police personnel, with demands for strict departmental and legal action.

#Mancherial #Telangana #PoliceConstable #DomesticViolence #DrunkOnDuty #LawAndOrder #WomenSafety #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Gutkha Found in Hostel Food Sparks Student Protest at MGU Nalgonda
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Nalgonda (Telangana): A shocking incident was reported at Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) in Nalgonda after students allegedly found a gutkha packet in jeera rice served at the hostel.

body.html:
Nalgonda (Telangana): A shocking incident was reported at Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) in Nalgonda after students allegedly found a gutkha packet in jeera rice served at the hostel.

The discovery triggered anger among students, who claimed that insects had also been found in the food on earlier occasions, despite repeated complaints to university staff.

On Monday afternoon, students came out onto the road carrying plates and cooking utensils and staged a protest, demanding accountability. Even after Narkatpally police reached the spot, the students refused to withdraw the protest until assurances were given.

The protesting students questioned the university administration, alleging that while the Vice-Chancellor strictly enforces the 75 per cent attendance rule, student health and food safety were being ignored. They accused the VC of being indifferent to student concerns and adopting an intimidating attitude.

Responding to the incident, Mahatma Gandhi University Vice-Chancellor Altaf Hussain assured the students that a detailed inquiry would be conducted and strict action would be taken against those responsible.

#MGU #Nalgonda #StudentProtest #HostelFood #Gutkha #CampusNews #TelanganaNews #FoodSafety

articles.title: CCTV Shock: Mahindra Thar Rams Parked Car in Greater Noida, Driver Flees in Broad Daylight
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: UP | Greater Noida: Another incident involving a Mahindra Thar has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Greater Noida, where a black Thar rammed into a car parked on the roadside and fled the spot. The incident took place on Monday at around 1:41 pm and was captured on a CCTV camera.

body.html:
UP | Greater Noida: Another incident involving a Mahindra Thar has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Greater Noida, where a black Thar rammed into a car parked on the roadside and fled the spot.

The incident took place on Monday at around 1:41 pm and was captured on a CCTV camera. The footage shows the SUV crashing into the parked car, damaging its front portion. A bike parked behind the car also toppled due to the impact and was damaged.

After the collision, the Thar driver is seen speeding away without stopping. The video has since gone viral, adding to the growing list of controversies and accidents linked to the Mahindra Thar.

articles.title: Haridwar Shock: Men Caught Drinking Alcohol on Ganga Bank, Woman confronted.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Haridwar (Uttarakhand): A video from Haridwar has triggered a debate on civic sense and respect for sacred places after three men were seen consuming alcohol on the banks of the River Ganga. The incident was recorded by a woman who confronted the men and asked them to leave the spot.

body.html:
Haridwar (Uttarakhand): A video from Haridwar has triggered a debate on civic sense and respect for sacred places after three men were seen consuming alcohol on the banks of the River Ganga. The incident was recorded by a woman who confronted the men and asked them to leave the spot.

In the viral clip, the men are seen sitting on the riverbank with alcohol. The woman questions their behaviour, saying they were drinking liquor at a holy site and warns them to leave or face police action. Following the confrontation, one of the men is seen throwing his plastic cup into the river before all three leave the area.

The video was shared on social media with users praising the woman’s courage. Many called her action necessary to protect the sanctity of the Ganga, while others raised concerns over the lack of civic responsibility at religious and public places.

The clip also sparked mixed reactions online. Some demanded strict police action against such acts, while others pointed out that pollution of the Ganga from waste and chemicals often goes ignored despite public outrage over such incidents.

The incident has once again highlighted the need for better enforcement of rules and greater public awareness to maintain cleanliness and respect at sacred sites.
